component.name: snapgo
component.summary: Capture a region of the screen and annotate it

description.p: Press a hotkey, drag a region of the frozen screen, annotate it in place and press Enter: the image is on your clipboard.

ul.li: Built for GNOME on Wayland, with pixel-exact output on HiDPI screens
Arrows, lines, shapes, pen, highlighter, text, numbered markers and blur
Annotations stay editable: move, recolour, resize or delete them
Pin a capture on screen, above other windows
A single-key shortcut for every tool, colour and action
